newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Imsa a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Imsa a strong buy.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said on Tuesday it had started coverage of Mexican steelmaker Grupo Imsa SA with a rating of strong buy.

-- "Our target price is $25 per ADS (American Depositary Share), which represents 32 percent potential upside from current trading levels," analysts Clicia Morales and Hillary Kircher Peruzzi wrote in a report.

-- "We estimate that Imsa's cash earnings will increase 60 percent from 1996-1998. This strong growth should be fueled by a 30 percent increase in unit sales of value-added steel products, higher capacity utilization and more sales in the higher-margin Mexican market."
-- They added, "We believe that the stock price does not yet fully reflect the company's growth potential or quality reputation."
-- Imsa's shares were up 7/8 to 20-1/2 in New York. The company launched an initial public offering last month.
